evidence_items.explanation: This is material counterevidence to reading 'take in' as video input capacity. The announcement describes frame-based processing without audio and does not establish reliable Simpsons comprehension or real-time Succession tracking.

HourVideo reports a substantial comprehension gap between Gemini 1.5 Pro and human experts on long egocentric videos. Different content, multiple-choice questions and an earlier model prevent it from settling the stated television-comprehension claim.

receipt.public_excerpt: a widespread susceptibility to hallucination issues

evidence_items.explanation: The evaluated models include Gemini 1.5 Pro, providing relevant evidence of hallucination problems. Adversarial yes/no questions and a 128-frame cap do not measure frequent heavy fabrication during complete-episode comprehension by the models available in April 2025.

The announcement states that Gemini 2.5 Pro was available in AI Studio and to Gemini Advanced users. Tests of Gemini 1.5 alone therefore cannot establish the capabilities of the available Gemini family at the post date.
